target: 穆枝神神秘秘地委托漂泊者運輸的箱子，裡面好像裝著一些黑石武器，交付人不明……

source: A bracelet given to you by Iuno.

source: A bright moon seems to hide in the crevice...
target: 裂隙中仿佛有一輪明月……

source: A brochure found in Averardo Vault.
target: 於埃弗拉德金庫收集到的宣傳單。

source: A brochure of the Lollo Party. Within its pages, moments from Forever Fest are preserved, each one ready to unfurl into boundless joy.
target: 嗚嗚派對的宣傳冊。承襲自無盡的宴會，那些定格的瞬間，可衍生無限的歡樂。

source: A broken old booklet recording the moon nursery rhyme
target: 記載月亮童謠的破舊小冊

source: A broken old record, it looks like a product from decades ago

source: A bullet-shaped metal, named Combustor for its peculiar shape. Specialized purification processes are required as it typically contains a high level of impurities.
target: 形似槍彈的金屬，因其奇妙的形態，被冠以聚燃體之名。通常其雜質含量都偏高，需要進行專門的提純處理。

source: A cada 1% de Taxa de Crít. que exceder 100%, aumenta o Dano Crít. em 2%.
target: 暴擊溢出100%的部分，每溢出1%暴擊提升2%暴擊傷害。

source: A cada passo, uma dança. Ele certamente alcançará o ponto mais alto.
target: 一步一舞，他一定會躍上最高樁。

source: A cake filled with honeysuckle paste, offering a subtle floral aroma and a distinctly sweet taste.
target: 使用鴛鴦花調味的酥餅，帶有鴛鴦花特有的清香，但是和淡雅的香味不同，口味相當甜。

source: A cake made by every household during the Moon-Chasing Festival.
target: 追月節時家家戶戶都會準備的糕點。

source: A calcified fang-shaped remnant of the Dark Tide creatures. Can be used to advance reward progress in Hunters' Rite.
target: 形似獸牙的黑潮造物鈣化殘片，可憑此在獵鋒禮典中積攢進度。

source: A camera from a well-known brand. They had a catchy slogan too.
target: 口碑很棒的相機系列，有著令人印象深刻的廣告詞。

source: A canção de aniversário de 2025, magnificamente executada pelo Pelotão de Pelúcia.
target: 2025生日紀念曲，由布偶小隊傾情演奏。

source: A canção de aniversário de 2026, especialmente readaptada pelos seus queridos amigos.
target: 2026生日紀念曲，由夥伴們為你改編的特別訂製版。

source: A captured fragment of a Tacet Return Wave, as silent as a broken string. Unravel it, and the Tacetite Bloom contained within will awaken in your hand, offering its soundless gift.
target: 一縷被截取的無音回波，如斷弦般靜默。啟封此物，其內所攜的黑石花將重現掌心，為你帶來靜默的饋贈。

source: A card issued by Jianji to the donors, which can be presented to Jianji to claim dividends.
target: 簡集發放給捐贈者的硬質卡片,可憑此在簡集處領取分潤。

source: A cartridge preserving memories of the good old days, alongside the final chapter of a true legend's journey.
target: 儲存著某人經歷的卡帶。它記錄著昔日的美好，回不去的過往，和一段傳奇的落幕。

source: A celebratory cake from the Spacetrek Collective. Don't worry—it's 100% free of food security issues.
target: 深空聯合出品的生日蛋糕，絕對不會有任何食品安全問題。

source: A challenge proof required to get the Seaside Arena ticket.
target: 獲取海場角鬥門票所需的挑戰證明。

source: A chart worth "a whole coin," carrying a hidden story, a big adventure, and... a person's untold life.
target: 價值「一枚硬幣」的海圖，代表了一段故事、一次冒險和一個人的一生。

source: A cherished item among the Rinascita people, it is said to hold music within, crafted by skilled artisans. However, due to internal damage, it no longer fulfills its original purpose.
target: 黎那汐塔人鍾愛的一種收藏品，據說心靈手巧的黎那汐塔匠人用工藝的方式銘刻了音樂。由於內部結構已經損壞，不再具備原本的效用。

source: A cherry blossom bonsai made by Chisa.
target: 由千咲製作的櫻花盆景

source: A cherry blossom bonsai made by Chisa. She handpicked the branches from Sakura Quarter, where you two roamed together.
target: 由千咲製作的櫻花盆景，櫻花花枝來自你們曾一同散步的櫻漫町。

source: A chip found in the Dim Forest. Seems to be the survey record of a botanist.
target: 在無光之森發現的晶片，似乎是某位植物學家的考察記錄。

source: A chip that can release pulse vortex.
target: 裝載後能釋放脈衝渦流的晶片。

source: A chip with missing content. Therefore, it cannot be directly used to optimize the performance of Echoes. However, by collecting enough quantity of these chips, you can still pick out complete frequencies with similar effects.
target: 內容有缺失的晶片，無法直接用於調優聲骸。但如果能收集足夠的數量，也可以篩選出效果接近的完整頻率集。

source: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It maintains a breathtakingly stable equilibrium. As a critical material for advanced technologies, it is subject to the strictest trade restrictions worldwide.
target: 呈現切削晶塊結構的海蝕遺留物，具備令人嘆為觀止的平衡態。由於該物質是許多高精尖領域的必需品，當今世界對其採取了最嚴格的貿易限制政策。

source: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It maintains a delicate equilibrium and, after centrifugation, its concentrated product becomes widely useful.
target: 呈現切削晶塊結構的海蝕遺留物，保持著微妙的平衡態。其經過離心機高度濃縮後的產物擁有廣泛用途。

source: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. It remains stable and, with the proper absorber, the contained Remnant Energy may still be extracted.
target: 呈現切削晶塊結構的海蝕遺留物，尚未處於衰退態。如果選擇合適的吸收劑，或許還能從中提取回音能量。

source: A chipped crystal of Waveworn residue. Originally a blocky structure, its equilibrium is broken, and its Remnant Energy has mostly dissipated.
target: 呈現切削晶塊結構的海蝕遺留物，然而其維持的平衡態已被打破，所蘊藏的回音已從斷面流失殆盡。

source: A chrysanthemum-shaped crystal found within jade. Elegant and unfurling, it is hailed as the "ethereal one among the stones."
target: 玉石中的菊花形伴生晶體，清雅舒展，被譽為「石中清客」。

source: A clear and sparkling star that shines just like the North Star in Pegasus.
target: 一顆晶瑩剔透的星星，就像《珀伽索斯》裡的北極星一樣閃耀。

source: A clearance module specially authorized by Carlotta, granting you full access to every section of Averardo Vault.
target: 由珂萊塔特別授權給漂泊者的權限組件，可讓你在埃弗拉德金庫內暢行無阻。

source: A coin frequency found at Forever Fest. Can be exchanged for decorations from Cobb Copo.
target: 從無盡宴會中找到的硬幣頻率，可用於在柯布·科波處交換陳設。

source:
A collection of raw test objects (cached, unnormalized, with comments still present). Analysis yields non-deterministic results.
"Wait, this is new to me... Hey, what're you doing to my surprise?!"
target:
快取、待刪除注釋以及未正式化的測試內容集合體，通過解析可以獲得難辨真假的情報。
「不是，這內容我都沒見過……不要啊，本王的驚喜！」

source: A combo featuring ham, roasted poultry, and grilled steaks—a true blessing for meat lovers. For Septimontian Gladiators, a post-battle celebration is all about devouring vast quantities of roasted meat.
target: 以火腿、烤禽肉和烤肉排為主的套餐，肉食愛好者毋庸置疑的福音。對於七丘的角鬥士來說，戰鬥之後的慶典就是抱著各式各樣的烤肉大快朵頤的過程。

source: A commemorative photo from Shixia.

target: 登頂屏庭山觀看日出時的紀念留影。

target: 登頂屏庭山觀看日出時的紀念留影。這一縷朝陽鼓舞著攀上高峰的人們堅定地奔向理想的明天。

source: A commemorative photo of you and Jiyan in the relay race.
target: 你與忌炎在接力賽的紀念照片。

source: A common Ragunna-style lamp that can be found in many places there.
target: 拉古那常見款式的檯燈，在很多地方都能見到。

source: A common Ragunna-style table-and-chair set, constructed from joined wooden planks.
target: 拉古那常見的桌椅套裝，使用木板拼接而成。

source: A common card, sprayed with the Exiles' favorite color, is an important access card to the Exiles camp.
target: 一張普通的卡片，噴塗上流放者喜歡的顏色，是進入流放者營地的重要出入證。

source: A common fruit known for being sweet, juicy, and pleasantly fragrant.
target: 常見的水果，甘甜多汁，香氣宜人。

target: 拉古那常見的落地燈。其上充當燭台的觸肢其實是某種構造簡單的聲骸，三不五時還會輕輕蠕動。

source: A common plucked string instrument from Rinascita. Boasting ancient origins, it remains a signature tool for wandering bards.
target: 黎那汐塔常見的撥弦樂器，其起源相當古老，是吟遊詩人的代表性樂器之一。

source: A common polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. The spiral structure is fairly complete. Seems to be an analog circuit recording the behavioral patterns of a Tacet Discord.
target: 常見的方形聲核結構，形狀複雜有序，呈現為完整的立方螺旋，彷若勾勒了殘象行為模式的迴路。

source: A common purple flower from the Septimont plains. Locals use it for spice blends or as home décor.
target: 於七丘平原生長的紫色花種。這種紫色的花隨處可見，七丘人常用其製作香料，也常將其插放到家中的花瓶中。

source: A common souvenir of the Moon-Chasing Festival that can be exchanged for exclusive rewards.
target: 追月節常見的紀念品，用於兌換活動獎勵。

source: A common thickening ingredient often used as a substitute for water in cooking to enrich the texture.
target: 常見的輔助原料，常在烹飪時作為水的替代，加入到菜餚或湯羹中，使味道更濃郁。

source: A common vegetable, occasionally carved into lanterns during certain festivals.
target: 常見的蔬菜，在某些慶典中，它們有時候會被雕刻成燈籠。

source: A common water purifier, designed as a standard device to ensure the safety of drinking water.
target: 隨處可見的淨水機，用於保障飲用水安全的典型裝置。

source: A communicator given to you by Lucilla. Designed in her personal style, this device is well-suited for covert operations.
target: 洛瑟菈交予你的通訊器，該裝置按照她個人的風格設計，具有較好的隱蔽性。

source: A communicator given to you by Lucilla. It resembles a makeup mirror.
target: 洛瑟菈交予你的通訊器，外觀與化妝鏡相似。

source: A compact magnetic chip encoded with flight data and combat routines. Used to grant EXP to Persona Pinballs.
target: 記錄著航行數據與戰鬥迴路的小磁片，可用於提升人格彈珠的經驗。

source: A component that requires a large amount of computing power to run. It can stably output power, and when loaded on a Terminal, it can significantly improve the owner's mobility.
target: 需要大量算力才能運行的元件，其能夠穩定地輸出動力，裝載在終端上後可以顯著提高所有者的運動能力。

source: A concha rochosa que cobre o braço do Beringal-feiliano, batizada em homenagem ao rugido estrondoso do seu soco pesado.
target: 覆蓋在飛廉之猩臂膊上的岩殼，因飛廉的重拳揮落之際的千鈞呼嘯而得名。

source: A condiment dubbed as the king of all condiments that brings the taste that's indispensable for every dish.
target: 有百味之首美譽的調味料。是一切美食不可或缺的靈魂。

source: A confection Yanshu asked you to give to Jingran.
target: 煙舒拜託你轉交的糕點。

source: A confection Yanshu asked you to give to Jingran. Seems to be fresh out of the oven.
target: 煙舒拜託你轉交給景燃的糕點，似乎是剛剛才做好的。

source: A confession letter Jiuwu wrote to Sonija, attached with several drafts.
target: 久梧寫給索尼婭的自白信，包括幾張草稿。

source: A confession letter to Sonija, bearing the marks of countless erasures and revisions. The final draft was never sent out due to a lack of determination.
target: 寫給索尼婭的自白信，經過多次塗抹、刪改方才寫成，或因缺少決心，成稿並未送出。

source: A copper mirror given by Buling.
target: 卜靈交給你的銅鏡。

source: A coward's heart seeks refuge in the shell of bravery.
target: 怯懦的心更愛寄居在英勇的軀殼中。

source: A crafted collection of recorded music, which, when given to the Aria Mummer, adds the tracks to their collection list.
target: 一種記錄音樂的工藝收藏品，交給留聲奏者後，可將記錄的曲目收錄至典藏列表。

source: A creative blend of black tea and iced tea. Two distinct tea leaves meet in a balanced harmony of aroma and mouthfeel.
target: 紅茶和冰茶相結合的創新茶飲，兩種原本截然不同的茶葉混合，創造出了新的香氣與口感。

source: A creative blend of coffee and bitter melon juice. Overwhelmingly bitter, almost no other flavor can be tasted.
target: 在咖啡中加入苦瓜汁製成的創新飲品，除了難以言喻的苦味之外幾乎嚐不出別的味道。

source: A crown that casts countless rays of starlight.
target: 留有萬數星彩的冠冕。

source: A crude ring that serves more as an identification than for practical use. It is used to display one's commitment to sever ties with civilized society.
target: 材質簡陋的鐐環，比起實用價值，更多是充當身份證明，用於標榜自己與文明社會徹底決裂的態度。

source: A crude voice material made by the Exiles.
target: 流放者自製的土法聲料。

source: A cup in the likeness of Namipon. Well-received and designed for cuteness.
target: 波仔樣式的水杯，造型可愛，廣受好評。

source:
A cup of seemingly ordinary shaved ice. Is it really as ordinary as it looks?
...Alright, yes. It is absolutely ordinary. But for Septimontians, this simple treat is one of the few chances to truly cool down.
target:
一杯看起來平平無奇的刨冰，真的平平無奇嗎？
……不用懷疑，這就是一杯平平無奇的刨冰。不過，品嘗刨冰的時候，是七丘人難得的冷靜時刻。

source: A cup showing Namipon in fashionable threads, brought to you in collaboration with a well-known project.
target: 和某人氣企劃進行聯名推出的波仔水杯。水杯上的波仔帶著新潮裝飾。

source: A currency for the shop of the "Stranger Things in Honami" event.
target: 用於穗波怪異物語活動商店

source: A custom weapon supply chest commissioned by the Spacetrek Collective. Inside lies the Synth Armament series, the dream equipment for every Academy student and researcher.
target: 深空聯合訂製的武裝補給箱，其中裝載著每個學生和研究員都夢想擁有的共生武裝系列裝備。

source: A custom-made Carnevale mask ordered by Carlotta for you. It draws inspiration from her impressions on you and Abby.
target: 珂萊塔小姐按照對你與阿布的印象，為你們訂製的狂歡節面具。

source: A customized 2025 birthday accessory for Rover. Before you even notice, this crown gently finds its way into your Backpack.
target: 2025年漂泊者專屬生日紀念飾品。回過神來，已靜靜躺在背包中的冠冕。

source: A customized 2026 birthday accessory for Rover. This circlet braided from starlight and Resonance Cord now rests in your Backpack, as if it had always been there.
target: 2026年漂泊者專屬生日紀念飾品。回過神來，由星與聲弦的交織而成的光環，已被收納在背包之中。

source: A damaged anklet, with a string of text engraved on the inside. After a long time, only the word "Institute" can be distinguished.
target: 損壞的腳鏈，內側刻有一串文字，經歷漫長的時光洗禮，只餘下「研究院」的字樣還可分辨。

source: A data card in the Dim Forest camp.
target: 無光之森營地裡的數據卡。

source: A data card obtained from the Dim Forest camp, old and rusty. Perhaps, it can be used to open the nearby iron cage.
target: 從無光之森營地中獲得的數據卡，樣式陳舊，有些許銹蝕。也許能打開附近的鐵籠。

source: A data chip picked up in the Port City of Guixu. Seems to be a battlefield record of a warrior.
target: 在歸墟港市拾取的數據晶片，似乎是某位戰士的戰地記錄。

source: A data chip, contents can be accessed through the Terminal.
target: 數據晶片，可使用終端查閱內容。

source: A data crystal generated by the system's backend, containing challenge-related data. Can be used to redeem event rewards in "Virtual Crisis."
target: 程序後台所生成的數據結晶，記錄了挑戰的相關數據，可在本期「虛域危局」中兌換活動獎勵。

source: A data device left by Qiongxue, recording the creativity of the two siblings in their childhood.
target: 瓊雪留下的訊息裝置，裡面的原稿記錄著兄妹二人兒時的創意。

source: A data log of a Black Shores' staff forum discussion record

target: 琳奈贈予你的科考摩托塗裝，作為相遇與並肩作戰的紀念。

source: A lua há muito foi destruída pelo Fenômeno de Erosionda. O que observamos não passa de uma miragem do passado.
target: 那月輪早已在海蝕中破碎，我們觀測到的不過是過去的幻影。

source: A lucky coin discovered while gutting a fish, bearing the mark of Captain Drake. Unfortunately, it's only a half.
target: 從魚肚子裡撿到的幸運硬幣，上有德雷克船長的標誌，可惜只有半枚。

source: A luz das estrelas cai no mar profundo, preenchendo todo o seu anseio e vazio. Na vastidão e solidão, ela vigiou as costas que existem apenas por causa dele... Esta é sua missão inata, tanto passada quanto futura.
target: 群星的影子墜入深海，填補了她所有的等候與空白。漫長地、寂寥地，守望著這片因{TA}而存在的海岸……這是她與生俱來的使命，是過去也是未來。

source: A lâmina exala uma aura tão profunda e misteriosa quanto o abismo do mar.
target: 長劍上散發著如深海般幽邃的氣息。

source: A maior honra concedida pela Academia aos participantes da Iniciativa de Pesquisa Científica da Geleira. Para Zhi Zhi, essas foram as últimas palavras que seu pai deixou para ela.
target: 由研究院授予冰原科考行動參與者的至高榮譽。對知枝來說，這就是父親留給她的最後的話語。

source: A maioria dos desenvolvedores de jogos em Solaris não faz ideia de por que um coração vermelho representa HP. Mas ei, se todo mundo está fazendo uma coisa, por que não seguir a correnteza?
target: 大多數索拉里斯的遊戲開發者並不知道為什麼紅色心形會成為生命值的象徵，但既然前輩都這麼做了，那照著做也準沒錯。

source: A manuscript from the Golden Anthem Poets Society preserving their poems and musical compositions, transcribed by Cristoforo.
target: 「黃金之歌」詩社遺作的一份手抄稿，由克里斯托弗手抄，上面記錄著詩篇與樂譜的內容。

source: A manuscript of Golden Anthem, transcribed by Cristoforo.
target: 《黃金之歌》的詩稿，由克里斯托弗抄錄。

source: A map that marks the locations of the cages in the eastern forest and the Hoochief camp.
target: 標記出東部森林牢籠以及搗蛋猿營地位置的地圖。

source: A marionete Ipsicorda
target: 機械人偶「懸絲」

source: A mask worn by Fractsidus active members. Due to long-term use, its ability to stabilize frequency has been greatly mitigated. One can clearly feel the torment of being drowning in negative emotions from the mask.
target: 殘星會正式成員的面罩，由於長期佩戴，其穩定頻率的作用已大大減弱，能明顯從中感受到被負面情緒浸透的痛苦。

source: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
target: 用於烹飪和合成的材料。

source: A material used for Cooking and Synthesis.
target: 用於烹飪的材料，也用於合成。

source: A material used for Cooking.
target: 用於烹飪的材料。

source: A material used for Crafting.
target: 用於印造的材料。

source: A material used for Lucy and Rebecca's Ascension.
target: 用於露西和蕾貝卡突破的材料。

source: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
target: 用於共鳴者突破的材料。

source: A material used for Resonator Ascension.
target: 用於角色突破的材料。

source: A material used for Synthesis.
target: 用於合成的材料。

source: A material used for Weapon & Resonator Ascension and Skill Upgrade.
target: 用於武器突破、共鳴者突破與技能升級。

source: A material used for Weapon Ascension.
target: 用於武器突破的材料。

source: A material used for Weapon and Tool crafting.
target: 武器和材料鍛造。

source: A material used in repairing the Somnoire. Collect to redeem rewards in the Somnium Labyrinth event.
target: 修復心之集域的材料，收集後可獲得「失序夢途」的活動獎勵。

source: A mechanical box left by Dewvetch to the old man.
target: 雲露留給老人的機關盒。

source: A medal awarded to the winner of Septimont's Agon of Champions.
target: 頒發給七丘角鬥冠軍賽勝利者的勛章。

source:
A medal split in two. Lupa wears the other half.
It's a testament to the applause you've earned in the City of Glory and the symbol of the triumph you've achieved side by side.
target:
被一分為二的勛章，另一半正佩戴在露帕胸前。
它是你此刻正沐浴著榮光之都讚美的證明，也是你與她一路並肩而戰的勝果。

source: A medalha do Prêmio Tochestrela estabelecido pela Academia Startroch.
target: 星炬學院設立的一門科學獎項。

source: A medalha perdida por Zhi Zhi.
target: 知枝遺落的勛章。

source: A medication for reviving downed individuals in emergencies. Its portable design includes a mechanical compartment with highly concentrated active ingredients for quick recovery.
target: 為在緊急情况下實施治療而開發的便攜補劑，將起效成分高度壓縮後裝入了機械結構中，能够快速喚醒失去意識的個體。

source:
A medida que las mareas se desvanecen y retornan, las alas de la mariposa baten con delicadeza, aguardando el transcurso de la noche interminable.
Aquí, donde las mareas encuentran su reposo, sus ecos persisten en el tiempo.
target:
潮起、潮落，蝶翅輕振，等過長夜漫漫。
海潮都在這裡停駐，浪聲都在這裡迴響。

source: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Broadblade Resonators.
target: 用於使用長刃的角色的武器突破與技能升級的中級材料。

source: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Gauntlets Resonators.
target: 用於使用臂鎧的角色的武器突破與技能升級的中級材料。

source: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Pistols Resonators.
target: 用於使用佩槍的角色的武器突破與技能升級的中級材料。

source: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Rectifier Resonators.
target: 用於使用音感儀的角色的武器突破與技能升級的中級材料。

source: A medium material used for Weapon Ascension and Skill Upgrade for Sword Resonators.
target: 用於使用迅刀的角色的武器突破與技能升級的中級材料。

source: A memento from the Dreamland, used to redeem rewards.
target: 來自樂園的紀念品，用於兌換獎勵。

source: A memória pode se apagar, mas essa amizade entre mundos guardará suas cores para sempre.
target: 記憶會褪色，但這份來自異界的友誼不會。

source: A menu board made by Namipon for the cafe's opening day, showcasing the new food and drinks to be expected.
target: 由波仔製作的開業菜單立牌，記錄著即將上新的食物和飲品。

source: A menu board made by Namipon for the cafe's opening day.
target: 由波仔製作的開業菜單立牌

source: A mineral that holds a glimmer of light. Can be used in the Moonlit Revelation event to decipher the Lunar Phases.
target: 貯藏了一束流光的礦石，可憑此在活動「月華解明」中進行月相解讀。

source: A mirror fragment reflecting the shadow of the White Cat. Used to unlock Dream Boon.
target: 倒影著白貓影子的鏡片，可憑此解鎖夢境演變。

source: A misplaced delivery box.
target: 遺失的貨件配送箱。

source: A mix of Sunflare Nectar and lemon juice, offering a lively sweet-and-sour flavor.
target: 由日冕蜜露與檸果汁製成的混合果汁。口味酸中帶甜。

source: A mixed floral arrangement dominated by vibrant blue tones, beautifully complemented by traditional ceramic vases.
target: 主色調為藍色的什錦插花組合，與傳統樣式的陶製花瓶相得益彰。

source: A mixed floral arrangement dominated by vibrant red tones, beautifully complemented by traditional ceramic vases.
target: 主色調為紅色的什錦插花組合，與傳統樣式的陶製花瓶相得益彰。

source: A mixed floral arrangement dominated by vibrant red tones, featuring vases inspired by the Genesis Nexus.
target: 主色調為紅色的什錦插花組合，其花瓶仿照起源信標的外形製作而成。

source: A mixed fruit platter featuring a variety of fruits. In every city-state of Rinascita, one can always find stalls piled high with fresh fruit along the streets.
target: 包含多種水果的混合果盤。無論在黎那汐塔的哪座城邦，街頭總是能看到擺滿各種水果的攤位。

source: A moeda de pesca circulada nas Ilhas Riccioli. Usada para comprar equipamentos de pesca e cobrir despesas diárias.
target: 黎喬利群島內部通行的漁業幣，用於購買漁材和平時花費。

source: A moeda de pesca em circulação nas Ilhas Riccioli. Pode ser usada para comprar equipamentos de pesca e cobrir gastos diários.
target: 黎喬利群島內部通行的漁業幣，用於購買漁材和平時花費。

source: A moeda digital de Night City trazida pelos Mercenários das Margens. Colete e troque por recompensas com os Mercenários das Margens.
target: 由邊緣行者們帶來的，流通於夜城的數位貨幣。可收集此物向二人兌換獎勵。

source: A moeda universal de Solaris-3.
target: 索拉里斯的通用貨幣。

source: A moeda universal do Cosmos Sonora. Pode ser trocada por suprimentos e recompensas no Mercado Stardock.
target: 索諾拉宇宙中的通用貨幣，能夠在星港集市換取物資和獎勵。

source: A moeda universal emitida por Huanglong, reconhecida oficialmente em muitas regiões.
target: 由瑝瓏發行，被各大地區的官方認可的通用貨幣。

source: A mushroom that grows in damp woodlands. It earned the name "White Jade Beauty" because its body resembles pure jade and its veil drapes gracefully like a flowing dress of snowy gauze.
target: 生長於濕潤林地間的菌菇，因其通體如玉、菌裙垂落如雪紗長裙，風致楚楚，故得名 「白玉美人」。

source: A music player in which the Black Shores merchant KU-Money keeps a playlist of personal favorites.
target: 儲存著黑海岸大商人庫默尼私人音樂收藏的播放器。

source: A musical record found in Nimbus Sanctum. This chorale was performed by the people of Rinascita long before the Order's founding.
target: 在氤柔水境中尋得的樂譜殘章，這樂曲早在修會建立前就為黎那汐塔的人們傳唱。

source: A mysterious coin uncovered while fishing in the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to redeem rewards.
target: 在黎喬利群島捕魚而發現的神秘古錢，用於兌換獎勵。

source: A mysterious compass, used to unlock Key Fishing Ability.
target: 神秘的指南針，用於解鎖核心捕撈能力。

source: A mysterious mechanical device. It activates the Serene Bay lighthouse.
target: 一種神秘的機械裝置，可以用來啟動沉靜灣的燈塔。

source: A mysterious pendant found in the secret chamber of Fogveil Pagoda
target: 在霧隱閣的密室取得的神秘掛飾。

source: A mysterious pendant retrieved from the Fogveil Pagoda. Seems to be a clue left behind by Cat of the Nether Lamp.
target: 在霧隱閣中取得的神秘掛飾，看起來是「鬼貓挈燈」特意留下的線索。

source: A música de fundo diurna do Seminário Teológico do Avinóleo. Obtenha a Caixa de Melodia desta canção da Múscia no Repositório Titular: Ruínas, Seminário Teológico do Avinóleo.
target: 阿維紐林神學院的日間背景音樂，在阿維紐林神學院·扉頁書館·遺址的音樂飛螢處獲得該樂曲的鳴奏之匣。

source: A música de fundo noturna do Seminário Teológico do Avinóleo. Obtenha a Caixa de Melodia desta canção da Múscia na Torre da Ascensão, Seminário Teológico do Avinóleo.
target: 阿維紐林神學院的夜間背景音樂，在阿維紐林神學院·向上之塔的音樂飛螢處獲得該樂曲的鳴奏之匣。

source: A natural dairy product, not only suitable for direct drinking, but also can provide a unique milk flavor for the dish.
target: 天然的乳製品，不僅可以直接飲用，也可為菜餚提供獨特的奶香風味。

source: A natural fruit with explosive properties that can be used as a substitute for a bomb.
target: 帶有爆炸屬性的天然果實，可以作為炸彈的替代品。

source: A natural instrument carried by Opus Otters. Every stone produces a distinct musical note.
target: 敲浪獺隨身攜帶的天然樂器，每一塊都能發出不同的樂音。

source: A necessary solvent for Resonators. It not only helps stabilize themselves but also enhances the numerical level of Waveplates.
target: 共鳴者隨身必備的溶劑，可幫助自身穩定狀態，提高結晶波片的數值水準。

source: A necklace found in the snow.
target: 從雪地裡發現的項鏈

source: A necklace that looks very valuable.
target: 看起來很貴重的項鏈

source: A neve cede em um instante. A brisa da primavera não deixa rastros.
target: 白雪須臾，春風盡散。

source: A new student ID of Startorch Academy.
target: 一張嶄新的星炬學院學生證。

source: A nightmare in crystal. Though its shell and the dreamscape it haunted have perished, this crystal pulses with a malevolent frequency, forever casting a shadow over each and every true love.
target: 噩夢的實體化結晶。即使軀殼熔毀，夢境消弭，其依然向外散發出不祥的頻率，詛咒著每一段真實的愛。

source: A noite foi longa demais, tão longa que nem mesmo o fim da escuridão infinita podia ser encontrado. Segurando firme a última centelha de luz em seus braços, em sua confusão, ela a confundiu com o alvorecer.
target: 這一晚實在太長，長到看不到漫漫長夜盡頭在何方。她擁著懷裡僅存的光亮，恍惚間將它認作了破曉的光。

source:
A note containing music scores of Solaris's unique music.
Collect a certain number of these notes to claim rewards on the event page.
target:
書箋頁，繪製有記載了索拉里斯獨特曲目的譜面。
收集一定數量後，可以在活動頁面獲得獎勵。

source: A note found behind the waterfall near the Three Heroes' Crest. Use to view details.
target: 在三王峰附近的瀑布後撿到的紙條，使用後可查看詳情。

source: A novel recounting the anecdotes of a Nethermancer.
target: 講述尋幽客往事的小說。

source: A nutritious ingredient made from beans, widely used in various specialty dishes due to its unique taste.
target: 由豆類製成的營養豐富的食材，因其獨特的口感而被廣泛應用於各種特色菜餚中。

source: A once fashionable flip terminal that still shows up in movies.
target: 過去很有人氣的翻蓋終端，許多影視作品中都會出現。

source: A once-popular game cartridge that enthusiasts often praise.
target: 過去風靡一時的遊戲卡帶，在愛好者中有很高人氣。

source: A once-popular game console that enthusiasts often praise.
target: 過去風靡一時的遊戲機，在愛好者中具有很高人氣。

source: A painting from another world. Is it a real piece? Hell knows.
target: 來自另一個世界的畫作。至於真偽幾何，你無從得知。

source: A painting gifted by the traveling painter Claudia, capturing a scene from the tower ruins.
target: 旅行畫師克勞迪亞贈送的畫，畫中是某處高塔遺跡的景色。

source: A pair of brass knuckles Zani used to wear.
target: 贊妮曾經使用的指虎。

source: A pale blue flowerbed that evokes the feeling of a clear, open sky.
target: 淺藍色的花圃，令人聯想起澄澈的天空。

source: A paper black cat gifted to you by Sigrika, a bit crooked, but very much heartfelt.
target: 西格莉卡贈送給你的摺紙黑貓，看起來有些歪扭，但卻藏著少女真摯的謝意。

source: A paper black cat gifted to you by Sigrika.
target: 西格莉卡贈送給你的摺紙黑貓。

source: A parcel to be delivered.
target: 一份待送達的包裹。

source: A pendant once worn close to Cartethyia's heart. It has somehow ended up in the hands of the Discord Slayer…
target: 卡提希婭佩戴於身的吊墜，不知為何落入了「獵魔人」手中……

source: A pendant once worn close to Cartethyia's heart. It seems she left a message within. Since her frequency still lingers within you, resonating with the pendant may reveal her message.
target: 卡提希婭佩戴於身的吊墜。卡提希婭似乎在其中留下了某些資訊，你的體內存有她的頻率，使用共鳴能力感知即可獲知其中內容。

source: A permissão de uso do Mapeador de Baús em Mengzhou. Para garantir a segurança da frequência em Mengzhou, os usuários têm permissão para usar o Mapeador de Baús apenas dentro das áreas autorizadas em conformidade com esta permissão oficial.
target: 奇藏測探儀在夢州及周邊區域的使用許可證明。為確保夢州及周邊區域頻率安全，請使用者持有此官方證明後，在已授權區域合規使用奇藏測探儀。

source: A personal belonging stored at the Hall of Foreign Affairs.
target: 被儲存在外事大廳的遺留物。

source: A photo Lucilla took in the Memory Palace.
target: 洛瑟菈在記憶宮殿中拍攝的一張相片。

source: A photo Lucilla took of you in the Memory Palace. Just a keepsake.
target: 洛瑟菈在記憶宮殿中拍攝的你，僅做留念。

source: A photo Matthew left for the Soliskin.
target: 馬修留下給日靈們的照片。

source: A photo captured by Fulmine, recording the moment you shared the curtain call with your companions.
target: 一張由斐林拍攝的照片，記錄了你與夥伴們一同謝幕時的情景。

source:
A photo captured by Fulmine, recording the moment you shared the curtain call with your companions.
You can zoom in to view the photo.
target:
一張由斐林拍攝的照片，記錄了你與夥伴們一同謝幕時的情景。
可放大查看。

source: A photo of an ordinary student dorm. The image was captured slightly out of focus.
target: 一間普通的學生宿舍照片，畫面有些虛焦。

source: A photo of an ordinary student dorm. The paper appears to have been gripped tightly, leaving the surface creased and mottled.
target: 一間普通的學生宿舍照片，似乎被狠狠攥緊過，表面斑駁褶皺。

source: A photo of you and Iuno taken by the Ceremonial Officer Bruno.
target: 禮官布里奧為你與尤諾拍下的照片。

source: A photo of you and your companions at the theater.
target: 你和夥伴們的劇場紀念合影。

source: A photo of you, Mornye, and Lynae under the New Sun.
target: 你與琳奈、莫寧在新日之下的三人合影。

source:
A photo of you, Mornye, and Lynae under the New Sun. With the light of Helios, a brighter future reveals before you.

"To freedom. To civilization. To new beginnings."
target:
你與琳奈、莫寧在新日之下的三人合影。「赫利俄斯」的光輝之下，更為廣闊的未來正在眼前展開。

「敬自由，敬文明，敬新生！」

source: A photo printed straight from the memory.
target: 一張從記憶裡列印出來的照片。

source: A photo secretly taken by the Plushie Squad. They witnessed your ascending to the top.
target: 一張由布偶小隊偷偷拍下的照片，它們目睹了你登上最高處時的模樣。

source:
A photo secretly taken by the Plushie Squad. They witnessed your ascending to the top.
You can zoom in to view the photo.
target:
一張由布偶小隊偷偷拍下的照片，它們目睹了你登上最高處時的模樣。
可放大查看。

source: A photo taken before a certain individual left the lab. For some reason, they didn't take it with them, choosing instead to carry away something far more precious.
target: 某人離開研究所前拍下的照片，但因為某些原因沒能如願拿走——他選擇帶更重要的東西離開。

source: A photograph as good as brand new, with marks on it pointing to somewhere in the Dim Forest. Perhaps it's a map to treasures.
target: 一張光潔如新的實拍照片，照片上面做了標記，似乎是在無光之森地區的某個地方，或許在那裡能夠找到些什麼寶藏。

source: A photograph indicating the location of treasures.
target: 記錄著寶藏所在地的照片。

source: A photograph taken while the old Institute was still operational. For its owner, it serves as a memento—the unpleasant kind.

不停搖擺的海盜船，電影中把它扔到真正的大海上就可以開始一場冒險。

A seemingly ordinary feather, soft and warm to the touch.

一枚看似尋常的羽毛。細膩而溫暖。
於活動事件【當你凝視夢淵時】中完成所有挑戰的證明。

source: A small token resembling ancient currency. Can be used to exchange for supplies at the Yard Exchange.
target: 外表類似錢幣的小型令牌，可在「井棧易物」中兌換物資。

source: A small, compact proportioning data card, the data of which is read by the Synthesizer to gain access to Synthesis' corresponding products.
target: 一張精緻小巧的配比數據卡，其中的數據被合成臺讀取後即可獲得合成對應產品的許可權。

source: A small, decorative Ragunna-style lamp, frequently used to adorn gardens.
target: 拉古那風格的小型裝飾燈，常被用於裝點庭院。

source: A smaller fragment of a wooden plaque with mysterious carvings, possibly used in ancient rituals. The meaning of the patterns is unknown.
target: 一小塊殘缺的木牌，牌面上篆刻了奇怪的木紋，無法辨認內容，似乎是某種古老儀式的祈願牌。

source: A soft pink flowerbed that evokes the beauty of dreamy, fleeting moments.
target: 淡粉色的花圃，令人聯想起如夢似幻的時光。

source: A softly contoured talisman with a lustrous finish, engraved with Royan patterns.
target: 線條柔和質感瑩潤的護身符，雕刻著羅伊族的圖案。

source:
A solid solvent made using a special process that imparts healing effects.
Allegedly invented by someone after going to Rinascita. Apparently, they really wanted to become a Master Echo Trainer.
target:
使用特殊工藝製造的固體溶劑，具有複合效果。
據說其是一位夢想成為聲骸訓練大師的人到達黎那汐塔區域後的新發明。

source: A song kept on an old phonograph record gifted by Lianna.
target: 莉亞娜贈予的老唱片中的歌曲。

source: A song kept on an old phonograph record gifted by Lianna. Unlocked after completing Side Quest "Moments Captured in Light."
target: 莉亞娜贈予的老唱片中的歌曲，完成紀聞任務「被光影定格的瞬間」後解鎖。

source: A song once popular in the Land of Xuanfang.
target: 曾在玄方地界廣為傳唱的一首歌謠。

source: A song once popular in the Land of Xuanfang. Defeat Thousand-Puppet Pavilion in Main Quest "Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled" to unlock.
target: 曾在玄方地界廣為傳唱的一首歌謠，在潮汐任務「玄翎振壑定瀾音」中擊敗千傀重樓後解鎖。

source: A song sung by the Troupe members. Unlocked in the Main Quest "What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing."
target: 劇團的成員們齊唱的歌曲，在潮汐任務「昔我悲傷，今卻歌唱」中解鎖。

source: A sorte também é poder.
target: 運氣也是實力的一種

source: A souvenir badge for travelers in Septimont. Can be used to advance reward progress in Gifts of Glory.
target: 勛章形制的七丘旅行紀念徽章，可憑此在榮光贈禮中積攢進度。

source: A special Coast Flax native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a roughing material.
target: 黎喬利群島特產的濱海亞麻，非常常見的粗加工材料。

source: A special Coast Flax native to the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to enhance Fishing Abilities.
target: 黎喬利群島特產的濱海亞麻，可以用來升級捕魚科技。

source: A special Palm Tree Log native to the Riccioli Islands, often used as a roughing material.
target: 黎喬利群島特產的棕櫚原木，非常常見的粗加工材料。

source: A special Palm Tree Log native to the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to enhance Fishing Abilities.
target: 黎喬利群島特產的棕櫚原木，可以用來升級捕魚科技。

source: A special coupon prepared by KU-Uigon for Black Shores staff participating in "Tidal Defense Simulator." Can be used to redeem rewards during the event.
target: 庫伊貢為參與「潮蝕模擬」的黑海岸人員所準備的兌換券，可用於在「潮蝕模擬」活動中換取獎勵。

source: A special firecracker made by following a secret blueprint found in Xisha. Refrain from using this in crowded areas as it is both powerful and loud.
target: 使用西沙所找到的秘方所製造的特殊鞭炮。 威力強勁，聲音洪亮，請務必在遠離人群的地方燃放。

source: A special item obtained after fully restoring the Plushie Village.
target: 完全修復布偶村後獲得的紀念道具。

source: A special material from the Bell-Borne Geochelone.
target: 只有在特定的頻率影響下才會產生自鳴鐘之龜的稀有素材，據說在熟練的藥師手中，可以精製成療效神奇的良藥。

source: A special material. A reward will be granted after you've gathered a certain number of them.
target: 一種特別的物質，收集一定數量後可以獲得獎勵。

source: A special product that combines potions of different potencies, which may provide a variety of unexpected benefits.
target: 將不同功效的合劑聯裝後製成的特殊產品，能够提供各種意想不到的增益效果。

source: A special reward obtained from the "Full Throttle! Bolt & Blitz!" event.
target: 在活動「奔馳！箭速與激情！」中獲得的特殊獎勵。

source: A special reward obtained from the "Stranger Things in Honami" event.
target: 在活動「穗波怪異物語」中獲得的特殊獎勵。

source: A special reward obtained from the "Tidal Defense Simulator" event. It records the highest TD waves you withstood in the "Total Defense Test."
target: 在活動「潮蝕模擬」中獲得的特殊獎勵，記錄著在「全局防衛測試」挑戰中成功抵禦的最高殘象波次。

source: A special reward obtained in "Virtual Crisis: Frontier Trials." It records the highest total Stress Level reached during the challenge.
target: 在「虛域危局·維度超驗」中獲得的特殊獎勵，記錄著曾在挑戰中達成的最高總負荷等級。

source: A special reward obtained in "Virtual Crisis: Prototype Trials." It records the highest total Stress Level reached during the challenge.
target: 在「虛域危局·原型解算」中所獲得的特殊獎勵，記錄著曾在挑戰中達成的最高總負荷等級。

source: A special reward obtained in "Virtual Crisis: Quadrant Trials." It records the highest total Stress Level reached during the challenge.
target: 在「虛域危局·象限延展」中所獲得的特殊獎勵，記錄著曾在挑戰中達成的最高總負荷等級。

source: A special species of Gulpuff. Can be used as explosives, thus they are known as "Bampuffs."
target: 一種特殊的咕咕河豚，似乎可以用來當做炸彈使用，因而又被稱為「砰砰河豚」。

source: A special species of Gulpuff. Can be used as explosives.
target: 一種特殊的咕咕河豚，似乎可以用來當做炸彈使用。

source: A special supply chest. Its exterior is made from high-performance materials designed to withstand extreme heat and pressure.
target: 特質的補給箱，其外殼使用了耐高溫高壓的材質，能夠有效保護其中裝載的物資。

source: A special voucher issued across Solaris, valued at 300 Lunites per voucher for outfit purchases.
target: 索拉里斯通用的消費禮券，使用一張禮券購買服飾時可抵消300月相。

source: A special-shaped key that can open the secret passage in the Dim Forest. It belongs to the zookeeper before the Lament.
target: 能夠開啟無光之森秘密通道的特殊形狀的鑰匙，是悲鳴前動物園管理人員的所有物。

source: A specialty bamboo shoot from the Land of Xuanfang. Shaped like the coiled horns of a mythical beast, it is exceptionally delicious.
target: 玄方地界特產的青雲筍，形似異獸蟠曲的長角，十分美味。

source: A specialty mineral with a shape of needle clusters. Sharp and tough. Mostly used in cutting metals or other crystals or making weapons.
target: 針簇狀的特色礦物，質地鋒利而堅硬。紅針晶簇的造物常用於切割金屬與其它晶體，或用作武器的生產。

source: A specialty snack from Homani City, which can be exchanged for items or used to upgrade Cafe Decor.
target: 穗波的特產點心，可以用來兌換道具或升級列車長咖啡廳裝潢。

source: A specialty snack from Homani City, widely praised for its soft, chewy texture and sweet, fragrant filling. Namipon's favorite. Deliver these to Namipon in exchange for items or use them to upgrade Cafe Decor.
target: 穗波市的特產點心，因軟糯口感和內藏的香甜餡料而廣受好評。波仔最喜歡的食物，交給波仔可以用來兌換道具，或是升級列車長咖啡廳的裝潢。

source:
A species of scarab that resembles a coin in appearance, with a reflective golden exoskeleton.
For Golden Thiefbats, Goldcrest Scarabs are both a pleasant sight and a delicious snack.
target:
酷似錢幣的金龜子，背甲反射著亮閃閃的金屬色澤。
對於星幣伏翼來說，盾金龜堪稱視覺與味覺上的雙重享受。

source: A spirit bird whose cry heralds the dawn; a morning star that lights the dark night.
target: 啼破黎明的靈鳥，照亮玄夜的曉星。

source: A stack of barrels filled with aging vintages. Many in Rinascita believe that the longer a vintage rests in oak, the better its flavor becomes.
target: 裝有陳釀的木桶堆。許多黎那汐塔人都認為，在木桶中存放的時間越久，陳釀的味道就越好。

source: A stack of old, candid photos, most worn beyond recognition.
target: 一疊被抓拍下的老照片，大部分畫面已因磨損而毀壞。

source: A stand-up card made by Chisa that conveys Chisa's special feelings.
target: 千咲親手製作的立體賀卡，附帶了特別的心意。

source: A stand-up card that conveys Chisa's special feelings, which she crafted herself while convalescing at the Black Shores. Zoom in for a closer look.
target: 千咲在黑海岸休養期間親手製作的立體賀卡，附帶著她特別的心意，可放大查看。

source: A standard kernel structure produced in massive quantities. This is the most ubiquitous model, serving as the default powerhouse for standard Autopuppets. Commonly found across a wide variety of models.
target: 常見的樞芯結構，是產量最大、正常機傀最常搭載的樞芯。常能在各式機傀身上找到。

source: A standard medication prescribed by the Retreat Ward for basic medical care and injury recovery.
target: 一份來自靜護閣的藥品，常用於處理傷病。

source: A standardized Terminal for the Spacetrek Collective members. Your Rabelle Cassette is stored within.
target: 深空聯合成員配備的標準化終端，你的「拉貝爾磁帶」已被置於其中。

source: A stew comprised of mixed protein and vegetables. The popular Jinzhou family meal allows for the preservation of the ingredients' natural flavors to the maximum owing to its simplicity and versatility. "Jinzhou Stew, Jingzhou brew!"
target: 將肉和蔬菜亂燉而成的菜餚。原料自由、做法簡單，最大限度保留了肉菜的原始風味，是今州人民最愛的本幫菜。「今州燴，今州味！」

source: A stone with carvings of portraits and Royan characters.
target: 刻有圖畫和羅伊文字的石頭。

source: A stored memory of your battles in Peaks of Prestige. Used to increase your level in the event.
target: 內含「榮耀之丘」決鬥錄影的記憶體，可用於提升「榮耀之丘」玩家的等級。

source: A strange Tacetite Bloom arranged in a spiral pattern. Can be used to increase the Syntonization Rank of Bloodpact's Pledge.
target: 以螺旋狀排列的奇異黑石花，可用於提高血誓盟約的諧振等級。

source: A strange book found floating in the Sea of Ghosts... maybe it's the key to a hidden bookcase door. This book cannot be opened, its contents will not be revealed... Perhaps that's for the best.
target:
「幽靈之海」中浮現的奇怪書籍，似乎是開啟某個書櫃暗門的鑰匙。
書本無法打開，裡面的內容無法查閱……這可能是件好事。

source: A strange book marked with traces of erosion from seawater.
target: 一本奇怪的書籍，有被海水侵蝕的痕跡。

source: A strange book with a fluid form. It is marked with traces of erosion from seawater.
target: 一本奇怪的書籍，形態不穩定，有被海水侵蝕的痕跡。

source: A strange book, aged and worn. It is marked with traces of erosion from seawater.
target: 一本奇怪的書籍，陳舊而斑駁，有被海水侵蝕的痕跡。

source: A strange data card. It is said that the encryption key stored within can prove the holder has made a financial donation.
target: 看起來有些怪異的數據卡,據說可以透過其儲存的秘鑰來證明持有者捐贈過一筆款項。

source: A strange diary, filled with childish and broken handwriting. It emanates a strange mix of Resonator and Tacet Discords.
target: 一本奇怪的日記，日記的主人筆觸稚嫩。從中可以感受到共鳴者和殘象的氣息。

source: A strange flower that blooms where the Dark Tide has receded. Though its core has been completely calcified, a faint fragrance still lingers—a proof that life's resilience shall never be underestimated.
target: 黑潮退去之地生出的奇異花朵，被白鈣化完全侵蝕的花蕊，雖然褪色卻依然留存著某種芬芳——永遠不要輕視生命的力量。

source: A strange fruit borne of the Voidbane Eldertree. Can be taken back to the Base Camp for further study.
target: 虛蝕古代喬木產出的奇異果實，可帶回基地進行研究。

source:
A strange glowing marine life found in the ocean depths.
The Rinascita legend has it that the Sentinel left the Abyss Luminaries beneath the waves to guide the souls of the drowned.
target:
生長於海底的奇異發光生物。
在黎那汐塔的傳說中，歲主將暗淵引燈留在浪潮之下，作為指引那些不幸溺亡於海中靈魂的信標。

source: A strange pact and its accompanying Echo, offered by an unnamed lady. It recreates fragments of the Sentinel's divine miracles in a mysterious way.
target: 不願透露姓名的女士提供的奇妙契約和配套的聲骸眷屬，用神秘的方式稍微復現了歲主的神蹟。

source: A strange-looking key that seems like it can fit into a certain keyhole.
target: 一把長相奇怪的鑰匙，看起來能鑲嵌在某個地方

source: A strange-looking key.
target: 長相怪異的鑰匙

source: A sturdy awning for the fishing ship, facilitating sea fishing.
target: 漁船使用的船篷，可以提供出海捕撈時的便利。

source: A sturdy, heavy-duty delivery box. If you happen to find one of these boxes abandoned by the roadside, please help recycle it.
target: 物流貨件配送箱，耐用結實，如果在野外看到相似的箱子，請幫忙拾取回收。

source:
A sugar cube supplement made from concentrated precious nutrients. Its active ingredients can be quickly absorbed by the human body.
Sweet and delicious, it's a favorite among children.
target:
將珍貴營養物質濃縮後製成的糖塊狀補劑，其中的元素能够迅速被人體吸收。
味道香甜可口，孩子都愛吃。

source: A sugary, salty beverage inspired by the favorite tea drink of the miners in Huanglong. During the cold winter months, a bowl of Salted Milk Tea can warm the entire body.
target: 高糖高鹽的飲料，由瑝瓏礦工鍾愛的茶飲發展而來。寒冷的冬天裡要是能喝上一碗鹹奶茶，全身都會暖融融起來。

source: A sweet Rinascitan-style birthday song performed by the Plushies of the Plushie Village, infused with their warmest wishes just for you!
target: 布偶村的布偶們為你演奏的慶生樂曲，加入了鮮明的黎那汐塔曲風和真誠的祝福。

source: A sweet and sour, bright red sauce that can provide a sweet and sour, rich taste to food.
target: 酸甜適口、色澤紅亮的醬汁，可以為食物提供酸酸甜甜的香醇口味。

source: A sweet oral vaccine, reminiscent of candy for children in Jinzhou, symbolizes their triumph over the epidemic.
target: 糖丸模樣的口服疫苗製劑，縈繞在孩提舌尖時的甜蜜，成為了一代今州人共克時疫的共同記憶。

source: A swordcraft manual with gentle Sword Energy soaked into it. Despite the passage of many years, only slight wear is evident along its edges. Its keeper must have treasured it greatly.
target: 秘笈周身浸潤著溫和的劍氣，雖歷經漫長歲月，外表卻只留下了些許磨損的痕跡。看得出來，持有者很珍視它。

source: A symbol of a trusted bond forged with H.E.R.M.E.S. Used to unlock and upgrade various clearance levels in the rider training.
target: 與漢密斯建立信任關係的證明，可用於解鎖和升級騎手訓練的各項強化權限。

source: A symbol of long-standing mutual trust between Rover and various affiliations. By establishing stable friendships with different affiliations, Rover may gain stronger support in the future.
target: 漂泊者與各個勢力之間長久互信的象徵，與各個組織形成穩定的友好關係或許能獲取更有力的支持。

source: A symbol of triumph and hope, never to falter or fall.
target: 成為旗幟，然後永不倒下。

source:
A symbol of your journey that can be displayed to other wayfarers.
Sigil can be updated in your Profile settings.
target:
見證漂泊者旅途的印章，可展示給其他旅者。
在漂泊者資料中可更換羈旅印章。

source: A table-and-chair set in the Montelli style well suited for business discussions or casual drinks.
target: 莫塔里風格的桌椅套裝。很適合在此洽談業務或稍作小酌。

source: A table-and-chair set in the Septimont style, featuring comfortable sofa-style seating.
target: 七丘風格的桌椅套裝，帶有相當舒服的沙發椅。

source: A table-and-chair set inspired by Carnevale. In this festive atmosphere, music is a constant—provided by lute players and wandering bards on every corner.
target: 狂歡節主題的桌椅套裝。音樂在狂歡節期間必不可少，而手持琉特琴的樂手和吟遊詩人更是隨處可見。

source: A table-and-chair set inspired by Carnevale. Nectarwine from Egla Town is highly prized in Ragunna, where it is also known as "Gocce di Divino."
target: 狂歡節主題的桌椅套裝。埃格拉小鎮出產的蜜露果酒在拉古那廣受好評，被譽為「生命之水」。

source: A table-and-chair set suitable for midday breaks. It invites you to sink into its soft chairs and bask idly in the sunshine.
target: 適合用於午休的桌椅套裝，可以坐在軟和的椅子裡懶洋洋地曬太陽。

source: A tabletop ornament crafted from various mineral crystals. In many places, these natural wonders are prized as elegant decorative pieces.
target: 使用各種礦石晶體製成的桌面擺件。在許多地方，人們都會將這些美麗的天然造物作為裝飾品使用。

source: A taxa de Saque de Itens de Raridade Dourada é aumentada em 15%.
target: 品質顏色為金色的物品出現機率提高15%。

source: A taxa de Saque de Itens de Raridade Roxa ou Dourada é aumentada em 10%.
target: 品質顏色為紫色或金色的物品出現機率提高10%。

source: A tela montada pela Logística Lollo e pela Academia Tochestrela ocasionalmente te lembra de assuntos além da festa.
target: 嗚嗚物流和星炬學院架設的螢幕，偶爾讓你想起派對之外的事。

source: A telescope awaits on the second-floor balcony for stargazing. Be sure to give it a look. (Unlocks at Vibe Level 6)
target: 二樓陽台有一台望遠鏡，據說，是為了看見星空（聚樂值達到階段6時解鎖）。

source: A temporary Resonance Beacon that can be flexibly placed, it needs to be placed by consuming the core module.
target: 可以靈活放置的臨時性信標，需要透過消耗標芯模組進行放置。

source:
A tiny chip that holds an irresistible pull for any Pinball.
"To the far reaches of the galaxy and beyond!"
target: 小小的磁片，對彈珠們而言卻有著大大的吸引力。「為了航行到更遠的地方——！」

source: A title awarded to master chefs who deserve their place in the hall of fame for both their art and their character.
target: 頒發給在廚藝與廚道均已臻於至境的優秀廚師的稱號。

source: A title awarded to those chefs who can already work without instructions. Many only make it here.
target: 給予已經能獨當一面的廚師的稱號，是很多人一生的頂點。

source: A title awarded to those chefs who mastered the basic cooking skills. Proof of a strider on the long path of cookery.
target: 給予掌握了基礎技能的廚師的稱號，證明著已經走在了漫長的廚師之路上。

source: A title awarded to those who pick up the kitchen knife and start the journey as a cook. A symbol of every cook's original wish.
target: 授予剛拿起菜刀的廚界新人的稱號，是每個廚師的起點與初心。

source: A token earned by submitting exploration reports from various regions. Can be exchanged for "Adventure Packages" during the Beyond the Waves event series.
target: 提交各地區遊歷見聞後所獲得的憑證。憑藉該道具即可在「踏潮探歷」系列活動中兌換"探歷補給"。

source: A token from Cantarella. A beautifully crafted vial adorned with a sapphire that represents the Fisalia family head's authority.
target: 坎特蕾拉交予你的信物，精美的瓶身上鑲嵌著代表翡薩烈家主之權的藍寶石。

source: A token of festival gaiety obtained in Solaris New Voyage Celebration. Can be used to advance reward progress.

source: Aunque el deber pesa, ¿quién podría resistirse a asistir a un festival tan magnífico?

傳說中，佇立於狄薩萊海脊的三重冠塔埋藏著翡薩烈家族最初的榮譽。

target: 凌陽演出時所佩戴的鈴鐺。作為一路同行的答謝，凌陽將其贈送給你。

source: The best movie is the next movie.
target: 下一部更精彩。

source: The blade exudes an aura as deep and mysterious as the abyss of the sea.
target: 長劍上散發著如深海般幽邃的氣息。

source: The bottle is etched with scar-like patterns... Is this intentional?
target: 瓶身上遍布著類似傷痕的紋路，是故意設計出來的嗎……

source: The box given to the Rover by the boss of the Boar Gang.
target: 豬婆幫老大穆枝交給漂泊者的箱子。

source: The brass knuckles Zani used to wear, as famous as the Blazing Nightwalker's tale itself.
target: 贊妮曾經使用的指虎，「焰光的夜行者」傳說的一部分。

source: The breath from the crevice brings peace and calm...
target: 裂隙中傳出的氣息讓人安心……

source: The card in Scar's hand with the mark of a black sheep. The flame attached to it seems to never extinguish. That flame will burn forever with Scar's never-ending desire for destruction.
target: 傷痕的手中帶有黑羊標記的卡牌，其上附著的烈焰仿佛永遠不會熄滅。而那股烈焰將與傷痕永不止息的破壞欲望一道永遠燃燒。

source: The cassette Aemeath once used, still bearing a sticker that was unmistakably hers.
target: 愛彌斯曾使用過的磁帶，上面還貼著一枚極具個人特色的貼紙。

source: The chaos seems to devour everything in the crevice...
target: 裂隙中的混沌似要吞噬一切……

source: The chip given by Jinhsi, which stores the research records of the Court of Savantae on the Sentinel.
target: 令尹今汐贈予的晶片，其中儲存著稷廷實驗室對歲主「角」的研究記錄。

source: The chip given by the Magistrate Jinhsi.
target: 令尹今汐贈予的晶片。

source: The clash of steel!
target: 鋼鐵的碰撞！

source: The combat data obtained from the Tactical Hologram: Calamity can be exchanged for various rewards in the Simulation Training Store.
target: 從全像戰略·強襲中獲得的戰鬥數據，可在演練商店中兌換各種獎勵。

source: The copper coins strung together are known as Yin coins in Mengzhou's folk culture.
target: 其上綴連的銅錢，似乎在夢州的民俗文化中被稱作「陰錢」。

source: The core module of the Waypoint, responsible for collecting, sharing, and updating location information. It connects the Waypoint and the Resonance Beacon, making it essential for initiating and maintaining the functioning of the Waypoint.
target: 借位信標進行位置資訊收集、共用、更新的核心模組，借位信標與信標基站的介面，是啟動和維持信標最重要的構件。

source: The core of Crownless's clone. Only more strife and sacrifice can mend the cracks and voids within this Tacet Core.
target: 無冠者分身的核心。只有更多的紛爭與犧牲，才能填補聲核的缺裂與罅隙。

source: The core of Tempest Mephis. Like a miniature thundercloud, the rumbling thunder spreads from the Tacet Core, causing the surroundings to quiver in its wake.
target: 朔雷之鱗的核心，如同一團微縮的雷雲，喑啞的雷鳴自聲核中擴散，周遭的事物亦隨之震顫。

source: The core of Thundering Mephis. Like a miniature thunderstorm, the core radiates a dazzling light between the flashes.
target: 雲閃之鱗的核心。如同一場微縮的雷暴，核心在頻閃之間輻射著刺目的輝光。

source: The core of a Stellar Matrix, where records of the key indicators of the Lament are compressed into.
target: 壓縮存儲悲鳴關鍵因素的星圖核心。

source: The core of a Stellar Matrix, where records of the key indicators of the Lament are compressed into. Upload it at the Modulation Hall to retrieve the data.
target: 壓縮存儲悲鳴關鍵因素的星圖核心，需要帶回調律大廳重新上傳。

source: The countless overwritten records epitomise your tribulations and the limit you have yet reached.
target: 於無數次數據顛覆中重寫屬於你的挑戰——這還遠非你的極限。

source: The currency used to exchange for items in Store.
target: 貨幣，用於商店兌換道具

source: The data source that fell from the body of the Mech Abomination. Appears to store information about the Court of Savantae. An old laboratory data source.
target: 從聚械機偶體內掉落的數據源，似乎存儲著有關稷庭實驗室的資訊，解析後可以被讀取。年代久遠的實驗室數據源。

source: The daytime background music of Avinoleum Theological Seminary. Obtain the Melody Box for this song from the Musicfly in Titular Repository: Ruins, Avinoleum Theological Seminary.
target: 阿維紐林神學院的日間背景音樂，在阿維紐林神學院·扉頁書館·遺址的音樂飛螢處獲得該樂曲的鳴奏之匣。

source: The digital currency of Night City brought by the Edgerunners. Collect and exchange them for rewards with the Edgerunners.
target: 由邊緣行者們帶來的，流通於夜城的數位貨幣。可收集此物向二人兌換獎勵。

source: The digital file of Professor Sevi's personal information.
target: 塞維教授的個人檔案。

source: The digital file that records Professor Sevi's basic personal information and major achievements.
target: 星炬學院塞維教授的個人檔案，其中記錄著教授個人的基本資料和一些顯著的成就。

source: The dried root of a legume plant, with unique food and medicinal value.
target: 豆科植物的乾燥根，有著獨特的食用與藥用價值。

source: The drop rate of Golden rarity Items is increased by 15%.
target: 品質顏色為金色的物品出現機率提高15%。

source: The drop rate of Purple or Golden rarity Items is increased by 10%.
target: 品質顏色為紫色或金色的物品出現機率提高10%。

source:
The duration of Sword Barrage is increased by {0}s.

Fun Fact
Cartethyia came up with some of her sword techniques while playing with her hand puppets at Avinoleum.
target:
「劍雨」持續時間增加{0}秒

冷知識
卡提希婭如今施展的部分劍技，是她在阿維紐林用手指偶靈光一現自創的。

source: The echoes within the rift are hard to discern.
target: 裂隙中的聲響你難以辨認。

source: The egg of the Jadeplume Eagle, an apex predator in the Land of Xuanfang. It is massive, cyan-green in color, and lustrous like pure jade.
target: 玄方地界頂級掠食者琢羽雕的蛋，體積巨大，色澤青綠，瑩潤宛如玉石。

source: The ending she had predicted never came to pass. What unfolded was yet another cycle.
target: 她預測中的終焉並未如期而至，而是成為了另一個循環的開始。

source: The engine of the Huanglong military robot, which looks ordinary, but is the most important part of the robot.
target: 瑝瓏軍用機器人的發動機，看起來平平無奇，卻是機器人身上最重要的部分。

source:
The ephemeral branches of illusory dreams.
"That is the proof of your encounter."
target:
虛妄的幻夢催生出了須臾的枝椏。
「那是你們相遇的證明。」

source: The essence of bravery shown by warriors, which charges up the Banners of Conquest.
target: 戰士們的勇武匯聚為狩獵點數，為不落旌旗提供能量。

source: The essence of tribulations endured by warriors, which charges up the Banners of Conquest.
target: 戰士們的磨礪匯聚為歷練點數，為不落旌旗提供能量。

source: The experience used to upgrade the Data Bank level can be obtained by unlocking new Echo.
target: 提升數據塢等級所用的經驗，可透過解鎖新聲骸獲得。

source: The eyes of this mysterious giant fish gleam with an eerie glow, and if you listen closely, you might even catch a faint melody within the flickers. Undoubtedly, it is one of the ocean's gifts.
target: 這條藍色斑紋的神秘大魚的眼中仍然閃爍著詭異的光輝，甚至還能透過那光輝聽到些許歌聲。毫無疑問，它也是大海的饋贈之一。

source: The first piece of background music played while confronting the Dragon of Dirg. The Melody Box of this track is obtained from the Supply Chest on the chandelier in the Echo Depository of Averardo Vault.
target: 與嘆息古龍對決時的背景音樂其一，在埃弗拉德金庫的聲骸藏館吊燈上的奇藏中獲得該樂曲的鳴奏之匣。

source: The first taste of it somehow stirs a sense of nostalgia.
target: 明明是第一次嚐到，卻令你感到懷念。

source: The fishery coin circulated within the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to purchase fishing gear and cover daily expenses.
target: 黎喬利群島內部通行的漁業幣，用於購買漁材和平時花費。

source: The fishery coin circulated within the Riccioli Islands. Used to purchase fishing gear and cover daily expenses.
target: 黎喬利群島內部通行的漁業幣，用於購買漁材和平時花費。

source: The foe, nearing its complete form, views this as the most potent weapon, which relentlessly sows seeds of destruction and awakens humanity's primal fear of war.
target: 即將孵化成完全體的敵人將它視作最為趁手的利刃，而它不帶任何憐憫地播種壞滅，再度喚醒人類對戰爭最原始的恐懼。

source: The footprints in the rift will never fade...
target: 裂隙中的足跡不可磨滅……

source: The frequency lingering on the cloth still echoes the battles of old.
target: 纏繞在衣角之上的頻率，承載著昔日爭鬥的餘響

source: The frequency lingering on the cloth still echoes the battles of old. Present it at a shattered Waystone, and the unyielding spirit shall answer the call, guiding the lost traveler forward.
target: 纏繞在衣角之上的頻率，承載著昔日爭鬥的餘響。將其帶至殘損的路標刻像前，不屈的英魂將回應呼喚，為徘徊的旅者指引迷途。

source: The fruit of Caltrop is known as tropfruit. It is produced underwater, beneath the plant's dense leaves. To obtain the fruit, the whole plant must be picked and the leaf must be carefully removed.
target: 白花菱的果實名為菱果，垂生於密葉下的水中，必須將白花菱全株採收帶回，仔細將葉與果分離才能取得。

source: The fruit of a legume plant, rich in protein, is known as plant meat.
target: 豆目豆科植物的果實，富含蛋白質有著植物肉的美稱。

source: The fruit of the Voidbane Eldertree. Its skin, structured like an optical grating, casts dancing rainbows across its surface when struck by light. A treasure for those who study optics, botany, and bionics alike.
target: 培育虛蝕古代喬木後採集到的果實，外果皮呈天然光柵結構，光照下虹彩遷流，有較高的光學、植物學、仿生學研究價值。

source: The gem obtained after the necklace was destroyed.
target: 摧毀項鏈後獲得的寶石

source: The gem on the necklace pendant, which seems to be inlaid somewhere.
target: 項鏈吊墜上的寶石，看起來能鑲嵌在某個地方

source: The gem on the necklace.
target: 項鏈上的寶石

source: The go-to bait for Riccioli fishermen, rich in the shallow seas.
target: 黎那汐塔漁民們常用的魚餌，富集於淺海，可以在海水中釣魚。

source: The good news? Your enemies won't see these weapons, so no alarms. The bad news? Neither will you.
target: 好消息是：敵人看不到這些武器，所以敵人並不會對它們產生戒備；壞消息是：你也看不到它們。

source: The greedy souls always complain that the world is not generous enough.
target: 每個貪婪的人都在抱怨世界不夠慷慨。

source: The grocer Mahe, who has traveled far and wide, has identified and prepared an ingredient pack according to the recipe. This pack contains all the ingredients needed to make the Jade Treasure Soup.
target: 雜貨商人馬和走街串巷、見多識廣，分辨完配方上記載的名詞，他按照配方逐一對照，配好了這樣一份食材包，包內含有製作玉珍薈萃湯所需的全部食材。

source: The group photo with your Companions after watching "The Tale of Demon-Banishing Asura" together.
target: 和夥伴們一起欣賞英雄戲《修羅除祟傳》後拍攝的紀念合影。

source: The highest honor bestowed by the Academy to the participants in the Glacier Science Research Initiative. For Zhizhi, these were the last words her father left her.
target: 由研究院授予冰原科考行動參與者的至高榮譽。對知枝來說，這就是父親留給她的最後的話語。

source: The impossible wish responded to her in another form.
target: 無法實現的願望，以另一種形式向她回應。

source: The information touchpad of Sizhe, returning it may have a reward.
target: 屬於思哲的資訊觸板，歸還也許有獎勵。

source: The instruction manual for synthesizing a Sonar Circuit. Use to master the synthesis of Sonar Circuit.
target: 合成尋音元件的指導配方，使用後會習得尋音元件合成方法。

source: The instruction manual for synthesizing a Waypoint Module. Use to master the synthesis of Waypoint Module.
target: 合成標芯模組的指導配方，使用後會習得標芯模組合成方法。

source: The jade pendant is clear and pure, reflecting the heart of its owner.
target: 玉佩清正澄澈，恰如持有者的內心。

source: The journey has come to an end. Her oath remains steadfast and sincere.
target: 故事中的旅途塵埃落定，她的誓言堅定真誠。

source: The journey has come to an end. Her three wishes have now all come true.
target: 故事中的旅途塵埃落定，她的三個願望也已實現。

source: The key dropped by Blobfly.
target: 飛獵手掉落的鑰匙。

source: The lantern is entombed in frost, as if a piece of history had been buried within. Someone cradled it, sinking into a deep slumber until the first breath of spring.
target: 提燈上覆蓋著厚厚的白霜，大抵是一段歷史被塵封其中。有人懷抱著它，在春日到來以前陷入深長睡眠。

source: The lantern-shaped Terminal used by Resonators from the Land of Echoes. Originally a gift from Sentinel Imperator to the people of Rinascita, it has since become their guiding light.
target: 「聲骸之國」黎那汐塔的共鳴者所使用的終端，形如提燈。它源於歲主英白拉多的饋贈，而後，成為陪伴在黎那汐塔人漫長求索之路上的一點明光。

source: The last commemorative item earned from restoring the Plushie Village.
target: 修復布偶村期間的最終紀念。

source: The leaf with a completely crystallized surface.
target: 表面完全晶石化的葉片。

source: The ledger of Lyu Yi, recording his day-to-day expenses.
target: 店長呂一的帳本，記載了他日常的支出。

source: The left plate, blanketed in dust. The right, scabbed. Your Honor, please place your weight.
target: 左盤落灰，右盤結痂。審判官，請放入你的砝碼。

source: The legendary first-ever game cartridge for the first-ever video game console. Revered by enthusiasts as a sacred relic.
target: 傳說中那款開山之作的初版卡帶，愛好者將其視若圭臬。

source: The legendary game console that ushered in the dawn of a new era in video gaming. Revered by enthusiasts as a sacred relic.
target: 傳說中那款開山之作的初版遊戲機，愛好者將其視若圭臬。

source: The lingering frequencies on the bracelet can help trace more of this Bloom Bearer's forgotten belongings.
target: 可使用手鍊上殘留的頻率，去定位這名執花更多的遺留物所在位置。

source: The living dwell upon the dark beyond, stubbornly denying the insurmountable divide between life and death.
target: 生者執念於黑沉沉的夜之彼岸，仍不相信生與死之間那不可逾越的距離。

source: The lost weapon
target: 遺落的武器

source: The lost weapon.
target: 遺落的武器。

source: The main source of sweetness, often associated with a sense of happiness.
target: 甜味的主要來源，常常被人與幸福感聯繫在一起。

source: The medal lost by Zhi Zhi.
target: 知枝遺落的勛章。

source: The memories we made together will be carried far into the future.
target: 那些一起的記憶，會延伸向遙遠的未來。

source: The metal scrolls with mysterious symbols seem to be able to create some kind of connection with Rover.
target: 記載著神秘符號的金屬卷軸，似乎與漂泊者能產生某種聯結。

source: The moon has long been shattered by the Waveworn Phenomenon. What we observe is nothing but the past's mirage.
target: 那月輪早已在海蝕中破碎，我們觀測到的不過是過去的幻影。

source: The more comprehensive data gathered across different simulation intensities become, the more Resonator allocation for future Waveworn Phenomenon encounters will improve.
target: 不同強度的對戰演習數據收集得越全面，未來應對海蝕現象、分派各等級人員時將會更合理。

source: The more data is collected from the drills, the more accurate the Waveworn Phenomena simulations become.
target: 演習數據收集得越全面，未來對於海蝕現象的推演將會越精確。

source: The most common bait in Rinascita. Casting it with Baiting creates an ideal Fishing Spot.
target: 黎那汐塔最常見的魚餌，透過「拋餌」技能釋放該魚餌後，可以生成一個優質的捕撈點。

source: The mysterious special ornament prepared by Namipon.
target: 波仔準備的神秘開業裝飾

source: The nest of Leafweaver, a kind of chirping insect. Meticulously structured, it is primarily built from leaves and petals.
target: 鳴蟲「葉中匠」的巢穴，多由樹葉和花瓣築成，結構精巧。

source: The night was far too long, so long that even the end of the endless dark was nowhere to be found. Holding tight to the final spark of light in her arms, in her haze, she mistook it for the breaking dawn.
target: 這一晚實在太長，長到看不到漫漫長夜盡頭在何方。她擁著懷裡僅存的光亮，恍惚間將它認作了破曉的光。

source: The nighttime background music of Avinoleum Theological Seminary. Obtain the Melody Box for this song from the Musicfly in Tower of Ascension, Avinoleum Theological Seminary.
target: 阿維紐林神學院的夜間背景音樂，在阿維紐林神學院·向上之塔的音樂飛螢處獲得該樂曲的鳴奏之匣。

source: The novel excerpt stored in the information device.
target: 儲存在資訊裝置中的小說選段。

source:
The old currency issued by Averardo Bank, which is no longer in circulation in Ragunna.
Nowadays, it is good for nothing but commemoration. Averardo Bank is working to recycle these antiques.
target:
拉古那不再流通的舊幣「莫內」，由埃弗拉德銀行發行。
現今，「莫內」的紀念價值已遠大於使用價值，埃弗拉德銀行正著手回收。

source: The original flavor of Namipon's Sparkling Water that can be found everywhere in Honami. Loved by both elders and children.
target: 原味的彈珠汽水，在穗波隨處可見。老人孩子都愛喝。

source: The original manuscript stored in the information device.
target: 儲存在資訊裝置中的原稿。

source: The painting captures the Blessed Maiden's contemplation in the Seminary. Though it has weathered the passage of time, her sacred aura remains undimmed.
target: 畫作上刻畫著昔日聖女在神學院裡凝神沉思的場景，即使時光流逝，這份聖潔也未曾改變。

source: The past cannot be changed; the future has yet to come.
target: 過去無從改變，未來尚未到來。

source: The peach blossom's beauty longs for eyes that see.
target: 桃之夭夭，灼灼其華。

source:
The perfect morning sandwich—delicious, quick, and wholesome.
Even the simplest bread holds infinite potential. Like life, a panini may seem the same every day, but it is always a little different.
target:
每天早上必吃的三明治，美味、便利、健康。
就算是普通的麵包也能融合無限創意。帕尼尼就像生活，日日都相似，每每都不同。

source: The photo that Duzhou always carries. In it are three people in Xuanfang Warden garb, laughing and embracing each other. At the bottom are written their names: Duzhou, Yanlang, and Mingyu.
target: 渡舟總是隨身攜帶的照片，照片上是三個身著定玄衛的衣裝、相擁而笑的人。下方寫著他們的名字：渡舟，顏朗，明煜。

source: The portable music player model used by the protagonist of a well-known work.
target: 某知名作品中主角的同款隨身音樂播放器。

source: The power that once carried someone through the mountains will remain in the mountains, remain on someone.
target: 那些電能曾經載著誰人走遍群山，此後也會留在山中，留在誰身上。

source: The precious experimental records brought back from the Tower of Adversity can be exchanged for various rewards in the Adversity Exchange.

source: Un matériau qui imite un cube métal standard. En situation de combat, ces matériaux peuvent être facilement remodelés en divers composants par le forgeur.
target: 模仿標準金屬鑄塊建構的虛擬材料。在實戰中，使用印造台即可輕鬆將類似的材料加工成各種工件。

source: Un matériau simulé, composé de données vestigiales, servant à renforcer les machines de combat dans le « Simulateur de contre-marée »
target: 由回音數據組成的模擬材料，用於在「潮蝕模擬」活動中升級作戰裝置。

source: Un matériau spécial. Récupérez-le pour obtenir des récompenses.
target: 一種特別的物質，收集一定數量後可以獲得獎勵。

source: Un matériau utilisé pour cuisiner.
target: 用於烹飪的材料。

source: Un matériau utilisé pour forger des armes et des outils.
target: 武器和材料鍛造。

source: Un matériau utilisé pour l'Ascension des Personnages.
target: 用於角色突破的材料。

target: 用於角色突破的材料。

target: 用於角色突破的材料。

source: Un matériau utilisé pour synthétiser.
target: 用於合成的材料。

source: Un matériau à utiliser pour l'Ascension de Lucy et Rebecca.
target: 用於露西和蕾貝卡突破的材料。

source: Un matériau à utiliser pour l'Ascension des personnages.
target: 用於角色突破的材料。

source: Un matériau à utiliser pour l'Ascension du personnage.
target: 用於角色突破的材料。

source: Un matériau à utiliser pour synthétiser.
target: 用於合成的材料。

source: Un matériel obtenu de Myriade des pièges - Corps brisé qui peut être pour l'ascension des personnages.
target: 萬囮牢·朽軀的掉落物，用於共鳴者突破。

source: Un matériel spécial de l'Association pionnière. Une récompense sera accordée après en avoir rassemblé un certain nombre.
target: 先行公約的特製紀念品，收集一定數量後可以獲得獎勵。

source: Un matériel spécial obtenu à partir de la Tortue des Sonneurs de cloches.
target: 只有在特定的頻率影響下才會產生自鳴鐘之龜的稀有素材，據說在熟練的藥師手中，可以精製成療效神奇的良藥。

source: Un medicamento que renace a las personas caídas. Su forma de dosificación portátil está diseñada para emergencias y contiene un compartimento mecánico con ingredientes activos altamente concentrados.
target: 為在緊急情况下實施治療而開發的便攜補劑，將起效成分高度壓縮後裝入了機械結構中，能够快速喚醒失去意識的個體。

source: Un merveilleux vieux bouillon à l'arôme parfumé qui fait ressortir les saveurs cachées des plats de viande.
target: 有著芬芳香氣的奇妙老湯，能激發出肉類菜品潛藏的風味。

source: Un message documentant la douleur d'une femme malheureuse tout au long de sa vie.
target: 記錄了一位命途多舛的女性一生之痛的資訊。

source: Un message étrange
target: 《奇怪的通訊》

source: Un metal con forma de bala, llamado «Combustor» por su forma peculiar. Requiere de procesos de purificación especializados, ya que generalmente contiene un alto nivel de impurezas.
target: 形似槍彈的金屬，因其奇妙的形態，被冠以聚燃體之名。通常其雜質含量都偏高，需要進行專門的提純處理。

source: Un millésime de Ragunna, généralement élaboré à partir de fruits.
target: 來自拉古那地區的陳釀，一般由水果製成。

source: Un millésime de Septimont accompagné d'outils de mélange, idéal pour être exposé sur un comptoir de bar.
target: 附有調製工具的七丘陳釀，適合放置於吧檯上。

source: Un millésime de Septimont, connu pour sa saveur audacieuse et robuste.
target: 來自七丘地區的陳釀，口味較為濃烈。

source: Un millésime digne de toute collection. Son arôme unique et sa saveur profonde ont été méticuleusement façonnés par le passage du temps.
target: 足以被稱之為收藏品的陳釀，流逝的時間賦予了它們獨特的香氣與味道。

source: Un millésime embouteillé dans un récipient inhabituel. Sa ressemblance avec le prétendu élixir de Fisalia lui a valu ce nom unique.
target: 使用奇怪容器分裝的陳釀，因為形似傳聞中翡薩烈家族的秘藥，因而獲得了這個名字。

source: Un minerai renfermant un éclat de lumière. À utiliser dans l'événement « Révélation lunaire » pour déchiffrer les phases de la lune.
target: 貯藏了一束流光的礦石，可憑此在活動「月華解明」中進行月相解讀。

source: Un minerai ressemblant à l'écaille de la Sentinelle. Peut servir à réparer les armes.
target: 形似歲主鱗片的礦石，可用於修繕武器。

source: Un mineral ampliamente distribuido, cuyo único color púrpura profundo es altamente reconocible. Debido a su textura frágil, este mineral tiene requisitos muy altos para el equipo de procesamiento.
target: 分佈廣泛的礦物，那獨一無二的深邃紫色卻極具辨識度。因為質地易碎，這種礦物對於加工設備的要求也非常高。

source: Un mineral cuyo interior emite un brillo. Puede usarse en el evento «Revelación lunar» para descifrar las fases lunares.
target: 貯藏了一束流光的礦石，可憑此在活動「月華解明」中進行月相解讀。

source: Un mineral distintivo en forma de un racimo de agujas, agudo y duro en textura. Las creaciones hechas de Escarlasta a menudo se utilizan para cortar metal y otros cristales, o para la producción de armas.
target: 針簇狀的特色礦物，質地鋒利而堅硬。紅針晶簇的造物常用於切割金屬與其它晶體，或用作武器的生產。

source: Un minéral distinctif en forme de grappe d'aiguilles, tranchant et dur en texture. Les créations des cristaux rouges sont souvent utilisées pour couper le métal et d'autres cristaux, ou pour la production d'armes.
target: 針簇狀的特色礦物，質地鋒利而堅硬。紅針晶簇的造物常用於切割金屬與其它晶體，或用作武器的生產。

source: Un miroir brisé qui réfléchit l'ombre du Chat blanc. Mais quel côté du miroir révèle la vérité ? Quel côté n'est qu'illusion ? C'est comme un rêve.
target: 一塊殘缺的鏡片，倒映著白貓的影子，鏡片的兩面究竟誰是真，誰是假？就如同踏入夢境一般。

source: Un miroir de cuivre donné par Buling.
target: 卜靈交給你的銅鏡。

source: Un misterioso colgante hallado en la cámara secreta de la Pagoda Velobrumoso
target: 在霧隱閣的密室取得的神秘掛飾。

source: Un misterioso colgante recuperado de la Pagoda Velobrumoso. Parece ser una pista dejada por el Gato del Farol del Inframundo.
target: 在霧隱閣中取得的神秘掛飾，看起來是「鬼貓挈燈」特意留下的線索。

source: Un misterioso dispositivo mecánico que puede ser usado para activar el faro de la Bahía Serena.
target: 一種神秘的機械裝置，可以用來啟動沉靜灣的燈塔。

source: Un modificador que permite ajustar el atributo principal de un Eco seleccionado.
target: 可重構聲骸屬性的調頻儀

source: Un module de données pour les Cubes. À équiper pour infliger des dégâts supplémentaires par seconde lorsque vous infligez des dégâts continus.
target: 團子所使用的數據模組，裝備者的持續類傷害技能，每秒將額外造成若干次傷害。

source: Un moment magique où vos destins se sont entremêlés sous les feux de la rampe, portant tous ensemble vos espoirs vers le printemps.
target: 彼此的時光在舞台上交匯，照亮春日的祈願。

source: Un moment promis
target: 此刻悄然應許

source: Un montón de regalos de las tiendas de Raguna que contienen adornos o máscaras. Se reparten gratis tanto a ciudadanos como a visitantes durante el Carnevale.
target: 由拉古那店鋪準備的禮物堆，內含小裝飾品或面具，會在狂歡節期間免費發放給市民和遊客。

source:
Un morceau brisé d'une pierre d'ancrage, émettant encore le champ de force.
« Que ce petit morceau de pierre ouvre en grand l'interstice des portes du destin. »
target: 一小塊破碎的定向錨，仍不竭地釋放著恆常而不可侵的力場。「就讓這枚小東西為我們撬開命運之門的裂隙。」

source: Un morceau brisé d'une pierre d'ancrage.
target: 破碎的定向錨之一片。

source: Un morceau brisé d'une pierre d'ancrage. Il faut à tout prix remettre cela au Souverain apocryphe.
target: 破碎的定向錨之一片。請務必設法將其送至偽作的神王的體內。

source: Un morceau de papier trouvé sur le corps d'un gladiateur.
target: 於陣亡角鬥士身上回收的紙條。

source: Un mueble vinoteca como los que hay en los bares detrás de la barra. La variedad y calidad de estas reservas suelen definir la reputación de un restaurante.
target: 常見於餐館吧檯的陳釀櫃。陳釀的種類和品質往往能成為餐館的招牌。

source: Un mystérieux mécanisme qui permet d'activer le phare de la Baie de sérénité.
target: 一種神秘的機械裝置，可以用來啟動沉靜灣的燈塔。

source: Un mystérieux pendentif découvert dans la chambre secrète de la Pagode de Brumevoile.
target: 在霧隱閣的密室取得的神秘掛飾。

source: Un mystérieux pendentif récupéré dans la Pagode de Brumevoile. Il semble s'agir d'un indice laissé par le Chat-lampe du Néant.
target: 在霧隱閣中取得的神秘掛飾，看起來是「鬼貓挈燈」特意留下的線索。

source: Un mélange créatif glacé. Deux feuilles de thé distinctes se marient dans une harmonie équilibrée d'arômes et de sensations en bouche.
target: 紅茶和冰茶相結合的創新茶飲，兩種原本截然不同的茶葉混合，創造出了新的香氣與口感。

source: Un mélange de nectar de fleur solaire éternelle et de jus d'olive, combinant deux des produits locaux les plus appréciés à Rinascita.
target: 將日冕蜜露和橄欖汁進行混合的飲料，是黎那汐塔最受歡迎水果的最佳組合。

source: Un métal en forme de balle, appelé Combustor à cause de sa forme particulière. Il nécessite un processus de purification spécifique, car il contient souvent beaucoup d'impuretés.
target: 形似槍彈的金屬，因其奇妙的形態，被冠以聚燃體之名。通常其雜質含量都偏高，需要進行專門的提純處理。

source: Un módulo Un módulo de datos para Dango que puede reducir la REU de habilidad.
target: 團子所使用的數據模組，能降低裝備者技能的冷卻時間。

source: Un módulo de datos para Dango que puede aumentar la cantidad de proyectiles.
target: 團子所使用的數據模組，將增加裝備者技能的投射物數量。

source: Un módulo de datos para Dango que puede aumentar la curación.
target: 團子所使用的數據模組，能夠提升治療量。

source: Un módulo de datos para Dango que puede aumentar la duración de habilidad.
target: 團子所使用的數據模組，能提升裝備者技能的持續時間。

source: Un módulo de datos para Dango que puede aumentar los PS.
target: 團子所使用的數據模組，能提升裝備者的生命。

source: Un módulo de datos para Dango. Las habilidades de daño continuo del portador infligen varios daños extra por segundo.
target: 團子所使用的數據模組，裝備者的持續類傷害技能，每秒將額外造成若干次傷害。

source: Un módulo de hackeo rápido de Lucy. Se puede usar para hackear los distintos mecanismos de Somnolencia: Night City.
target: 露西提供的速駭模組。可用於快速駭入心之集域·夜城內的機關。

source: Un módulo de memoria que contiene grabaciones de duelos de Cumbre Gloriosa. Puede usarse para subir de nivel al jugador en este modo.
target: 內含「榮耀之丘」決鬥錄影的記憶體，可用於提升「榮耀之丘」玩家的等級。

source: Un navire du Tribunal de l'Ordre qui arrive toujours à temps pour « médier » les conflits sur la mer. Ils peuvent avoir « absous » les coupables, mais les autres ne les « absolvent » jamais.
target: 巡遊在大海上的赦免院船隻，總能及時趕到衝突處給予「調停」。也許他「赦免」了有罪者，但很明顯有些人不會放過他。

source: Un navire naufragé dans la lutte pour son sceau. La trahison a mis ses voiles en feu, renversé ses mâts, et n'a laissé que ce sceau.
target: 因爭奪印章而墜毀的船隻，陰謀詭計將船帆點燃，桅杆推倒，到最後只剩印章。

source: Un navire pirate errant dans la brume, connu pour instiller une peur éternelle avec les tricks les plus simples.
target: 遊蕩於迷霧中的海盜船隻，擅長用最樸實的手段給予受害者長久的恐懼。

source: Un nouveau numéro d'étudiant de l'Académie Brandétoile.
target: 一張嶄新的星炬學院學生證。

source: Un noyau à structure faible, délivrant une énergie limitée. En tant que source d'énergie minimale, il restreint les automates aux commandes les plus simples et se retrouve fréquemment sur les modèles les plus faibles.
target: 弱小的樞芯結構，提供的能量極其有限，其驅動的機傀往往只能完成最簡單的指令。常能在弱小的機傀身上找到。

source: Un noyau à structure puissante, générant une quantité massive d'énergie. Il permet aux automates d'exécuter des commandes d'une complexité exceptionnelle et s'obtient uniquement sur les modèles rares et redoutables.
target: 強大的樞芯結構，能提供龐大的能量，其驅動的機傀能夠完成極其複雜的指令。僅能在偶爾遇見的強大機傀身上找到。

source: Un noyau à structure standard, produit en grande série. En tant que source d'énergie la plus commune, il alimente par défaut les automates ordinaires et se retrouve sur une grande variété de modèles.
target: 常見的樞芯結構，是產量最大、正常機傀最常搭載的樞芯。常能在各式機傀身上找到。

source: Un núcleo poligonal común con un intrincado patrón escalonado. La estructura en espiral está bastante completa. Parece ser un circuito analógico que registra los patrones de comportamiento de una Disonancia Tácita.
target: 常見的方形聲核結構，形狀複雜有序，呈現為完整的立方螺旋，彷若勾勒了殘象行為模式的迴路。

source: Un núcleo poligonal fracturado con un intrincado patrón escalonado. Se pueden ver grietas en su frágil estructura en espiral. Parece ser una unidad de energía simple de una Disonancia Tácita.
target: 弱小的方形聲核結構，形狀複雜有序，呈現為單薄、缺裂的立方螺旋，如同驅役殘象行動的簡易單元。

source: Un objet d'art qui peut enregistrer la musique. Donnez-le à Mime Aria pour ajouter de la musique à votre collection.
target: 一種記錄音樂的工藝收藏品，交給留聲奏者後，可將記錄的曲目收錄至典藏列表。

source: Un objet de collection adoré par les gens de Rinascita. Un artisan talentueux l'a créé pour enregistrer la musique d'une manière spéciale. Comme la structure dedans a été cassée, il ne fonctionne plus.
target: 黎那汐塔人鍾愛的一種收藏品，據說心靈手巧的黎那汐塔匠人用工藝的方式銘刻了音樂。由於內部結構已經損壞，不再具備原本的效用。

source: Un objet de collection adoré par les gens de Rinascita. Un artisan talentueux l'a créé pour enregistrer la musique d'une manière spéciale. Comme sa structure interne a été brisée, il ne fonctionne plus.
target: 黎那汐塔人鍾愛的一種收藏品，據說心靈手巧的黎那汐塔匠人用工藝的方式銘刻了音樂。由於內部結構已經損壞，不再具備原本的效用。

source: Un objet en forme de clé

target: 天傀劫煞的掉落物，用於共鳴者突破。

source: Un objet obtenu en passant le rêve inexistant.
target: 在心之集域中通過不存在的夢境獲得的道具。

source: Un objet obtenu en terminant le Rêve Inexistant.
target: 在心之集域中通過不存在的夢境獲得的道具。

source: Un objet obtenu en vainquant Sans délire à Somnoire.

source: Un objet obtenu en vainquant le Sans délire à Somnoire.

source: Un objet qui prouve le libre accès au camp d'exil.
target: 自由出入流放者營地的證明物件。

source: Un objet servant d'accès à la célébration de l'anniversaire de 2025. Utilisé pour revoir les bénédictions envoyées par tes partenaires.
target: 2025年生日紀念入口，使用後可以回顧友人的祝福。

source: Un objet servant d'accès à la célébration de l'anniversaire. Utilisé pour revoir les bénédictions envoyées par tes partenaires.
target: 2026年生日紀念入口，使用後可以回顧友人的祝福。

source: Un objet spécial obtenu après avoir entièrement restauré le Village des Peluches.
target: 完全修復布偶村後獲得的紀念道具。

source: Un objet spécial pour débloquer les « Traces des écailles ».
target: 特殊的道具，可用於開啟長路鱗跡。

source: Un objet spécial. Équipez-le pour accéder aux « Traces des écailles ».

source: Una lámpara diseñada en el estilo distintivo de la Bóveda de Averardo. Emite una luz suave que no deslumbra. Elegante y sutil, cada uno de los detalles del diseño refleja la filosofía de la Bóveda, que prioriza al cliente por encima de todo.
target: 埃弗拉德金庫風格的落地燈，光照柔和且不刺眼，外表典雅卻不奢華。無處不體現著埃弗拉德金庫以客戶為本的宗旨。

source: Una maravillosa sopa antigua con un aroma fragante que puede resaltar los sabores ocultos de los platos de carne.
target: 有著芬芳香氣的奇妙老湯，能激發出肉類菜品潛藏的風味。

source: Una materia prima para elaborar las mejores armas de Septimont, meticulosamente moldeada por los artesanos de estas tierras en forma de pluma de grifo. Aunque es fría al tacto, arde con una obstinación intemperante.
target: 七丘工匠將武器坯料鑄成獅鷲紋樣，冰冷的金屬隱含銳意。

source: Una medalla que lleva el emblema de la familia Fisalia.
target: 刻有翡薩烈家族紋樣的徽章。

source:
Una medalla rota en dos mitades, cuya otra parte lleva Lupa.
Es el testimonio de que ahora compartes la gloria y el honor de la ciudad de la gloria, y del triunfo conquistado junto a ella en cada batalla.
target:
被一分為二的勛章，另一半正佩戴在露帕胸前。
它是你此刻正沐浴著榮光之都讚美的證明，也是你與她一路並肩而戰的勝果。

source: Una mena que se asemeja a la escama de la Centinela. Puede usarse para reparar armas.
target: 形似歲主鱗片的礦石，可用於修繕武器。

source: Una merienda que incluye café y magdalenas. Para los raguneses, la merienda es tan importante como cualquier otra comida principal.
target: 配有咖啡和杯子蛋糕的下午茶套餐。對大多數拉古那人而言，下午茶和正餐都同樣重要。

source: Una mezcla creativa de té negro y té helado. Dos hojas de té distintas se encuentran en una armonía balanceada de aroma y palatabilidad.
target: 紅茶和冰茶相結合的創新茶飲，兩種原本截然不同的茶葉混合，創造出了新的香氣與口感。

source: Una mezcla de néctar brillante y jugo de limón, que ofrece un sabor agridulce vigoroso.
target: 由日冕蜜露與檸果汁製成的混合果汁。口味酸中帶甜。

source: Una mitad de un colgante de jade que tiene la hermana de Yunlu, parece coincidir con el colgante de jade que tiene Yunlu.
target: 雲露的妹妹所持有的半塊玉佩，看上去與雲露持有的玉佩成對。

source: Una moneda completa. Bajo la luz de la luna, el mapa que la moneda revela señala el tesoro de Drake.
target: 一枚完整的硬幣。在月光下，硬幣顯現出的地圖指向了德雷克的寶藏。

source: Una moneda de la suerte encontrada en el estómago de un pez, con el símbolo del capitán Drake, pero lamentablemente solo está en la mitad.
target: 從魚肚子裡撿到的幸運硬幣，上有德雷克船長的標誌，可惜只有半枚。

source: Una moneda enigmática hallada durante la pesca en las islas Riccioli, útil para canjear recompensas.
target: 在黎喬利群島捕魚而發現的神秘古錢，用於兌換獎勵。

source: Una máscara de los miembros oficiales de los Fractsidus, debido al uso a largo plazo, el efecto de su frecuencia estable se ha debilitado enormemente, y el dolor empapado por las emociones negativas se puede sentir claramente desde ella.

source: Una máscara de zorro, presuntamente tirada por el sospechoso que robó la Ficha de la Centinela.
target: 一張狐狸樣式的面具，似乎是偷走歲主信物的犯人落下的。

source: Una máscara del Carnevale hecha a medida por Carlotta para ti. Está inspirada en sus impresiones sobre ti y Abby.
target: 珂萊塔小姐按照對你與阿布的印象，為你們訂製的狂歡節面具。

書箋頁，繪製有記載了索拉里斯獨特曲目的譜面。
收集一定數量後，可以在活動頁面獲得獎勵。

source: Una novela encontrada en un navío brumoso, que narra los misteriosos encuentros de un Nigromante por los Reinos Espejismo. Parece que alguien dejó algunas anotaciones en varias páginas.
target: 在雲梭上拾得的小說，講述了一名尋幽客在蜃境中遭遇的種種詭事。內頁有一些臨時寫下的留言。

source: Una novela que narra las anécdotas de un nigromante.

source: Una obra escrita por el misterioso dramaturgo Cristoforo.
target: 由神秘劇作家克里斯托弗所撰寫的劇本

source: Una pantalla sencilla, de estilo moderno. Este movimiento artístico interesa enormemente a la familia Montelli, por lo que ha reunido una gran colección de obras similares en su bóveda.
target: 現代風的簡約屏風。莫塔里家族對以此為代表的藝術風格很感興趣，因此在金庫中收藏了許多類似的裝飾品。

source: Una partitura antigua y rota, no está claro qué uso específico tiene

source: Una partitura que Ciaccona regaló, donde guardó cada melodía que grabó durante sus viajes.
target: 夏空贈予你的樂譜本，上面記錄著她過往旅行時記錄的旋律。

source: Una pesadilla de cristal. Aunque su caparazón y el paisaje onírico que atormentaba han desaparecido, este cristal pulsa con una frecuencia malévola, proyectando para siempre una sombra sobre todos los verdaderos amores.
target: 噩夢的實體化結晶。即使軀殼熔毀，夢境消弭，其依然向外散發出不祥的頻率，詛咒著每一段真實的愛。

source: Una piedra de anclaje que se ve algo desgastada.

source: Una piedra de anclaje que se ve algo desgastada. Al insertarla en un obelisco de anclaje, puede repeler la Marea Oscura y sus creaciones dentro de un rango concreto.
